video_title: NBA Insider explains why he doesn’t believe Giannis Antetokounmpo will end up on the Celtics

quotes.speaker: Andrew Callahan
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat trade package for Giannis Antetokounmpo was insufficient
quotes.excerpt: That offer, that package the Heat are offering wasn't good enough for Damian Lillard
quotes.quote: The Miami Heat have been in this not for weeks, but for months. Imagine someone offering you something for dinner to sit over here and you go, okay, what else is on the menu? And you let that sit there not for seconds and minutes, but weeks and months. You are not taking that offer. That offer, that package the Heat are offering wasn't good enough for Damian Lillard, certainly not good enough a couple of years ago, now for Giannis Antetokounmpo.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Callahan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown trade package is superior to Miami's offer for Giannis
quotes.excerpt: What better package could they get for Jaylen Brown right now? It's not going to top Giannis Antetokounmpo.
quotes.quote: If the Celtics really insist on a shakeup, what better package could they get for Jaylen Brown right now? It's not going to top Giannis Antetokounmpo. So the timing is good for them, it's a better offer than what the Bucks are getting from the Heat, which is the only other frontrunner here.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Significant risks associated with acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: Giannis missed a lot of time last year. I think he only played 36, 37 games.
quotes.quote: There's some risk involved. Not just minimal risk, there's some major risk. One, Giannis missed a lot of time last year. I think he only played 36, 37 games for the Milwaukee Bucks last year.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's fit and role on the Celtics is questionable
quotes.excerpt: He has always been the focal point of a team. He has been the face of the franchise.
quotes.quote: He has always been the focal point of a team. He has been the face of the franchise. Coming to Boston, sharing the stage with Jason Tatum, how is he going to be able to handle that? How is he going to handle the scrutiny of Boston? Where does he fit in on the Celtics?

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's preference is to remain in the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: It is believed strongly that Giannis wants to stay in the East.
quotes.quote: It is believed strongly that Giannis wants to stay in the East, and he needs to win. When I talk to people, the expectation clearly is we are nearing a resolution.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics are gauging the cost of acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics are gauging what it would take to get Giannis to Boston.

text_blocks.speaker: Gary Washburn
text_blocks.text: I don't think he's going to be a Celtic. The Celtics are gauging what it would take to get Giannis to Boston and trying to figure out whether they want to move Jaylen Brown.

text_blocks.speaker: Andrew Callahan
text_blocks.text: I don't think this deal happens without Jaylen though, from a salary standpoint.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Callahan
quotes.summary_phrase: Salary cap constraints make a Giannis-Jaylen Brown trade difficult
quotes.excerpt: I don't think this deal happens without Jaylen though, from a salary standpoint.
quotes.quote: I don't think this deal happens without Jaylen though, from a salary standpoint. We just went through all the second apron machinations and the punishments and the frozen draft picks and your inability to trade when you have so many large salaries because there goes Jrue Holiday, there goes Al Horford. You have three players now making over $50 million, upwards of 70, particularly with Jaylen eligible for an extension here coming up too. I think this would have to involve him.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's health and commitment are critical to the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen's coming off a career year. He's given everything he can in his 10 years to the Celtics.
quotes.quote: Jaylen's coming off a career year. He's given everything he can in his 10 years to the Celtics. Does he have flaws and weaknesses? Of course he does, but I think as he said in his Twitch video, he's going to be working on those. Does he come into this next season just as determined or even more determined than last year to try to atone for that first round kind of embarrassing loss to the 76ers?

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA is moving away from a three-point-centric offense
quotes.excerpt: It's not a three-point happy league like it used to be. It's declining.
quotes.quote: It's not a three-point happy league like it used to be. It's declining. You take selected threes, you take quality threes. You just don't bombard. The Celtics found that out in Game 7 when they were trying to come back and all they needed was a two and they just took a bunch of threes. But Joe Mazzulla, I do think is open to adjustment. You give him Giannis and he spends months trying to figure out how to maximize the talents of Tatum and Giannis.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's health is a major concern for the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: The concerns I have with Giannis is health-wise.
quotes.quote: The concerns I have with Giannis is health-wise. He'll be 32 in December, that he's had lower extremity injuries and that he's an athletic freak, yes, but he's also taken a lot of pounding. He's entering his 13th, 14th year. He was drafted in 2013, so he's been around for a while. And how much do you get out of Giannis? And if you pay him that four-year $270 million extension, does that come back to bite you if he's not able to make it through that deal?

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's trade rumors are a test of his resolve
quotes.excerpt: I take that as a trade me and see what happens.
quotes.quote: I take that as a trade me and see what happens. See what the next team gets and see if you regret that or not. I think that he has had a great 10 years, they've won a championship. There's always been this story with him and his relationship with Jason Tatum, but they're going to be paired for the rest of their days, right? They probably get their numbers retired on the same night. It's going to happen.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown is a cornerstone piece for the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: I would not trade Jaylen. I think that you have two cornerstone pieces to work with.
quotes.quote: I would not trade Jaylen. I think that you have two cornerstone pieces to work with. You build around them, you take advantage of this window and you try to win a championship next year.

quotes.speaker: Michael Holley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown has never requested a trade from the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: In 10 years, he has never asked to be traded, as far as we know.
quotes.quote: In 10 years, he has never asked to be traded, as far as we know. Yet his name continues to come up in trade conversations. One, what's going on, Gary? Why is that happening? And two, we know Jaylen Brown is a very prideful guy, he's got a lot of belief in himself. Is this something where they keep doing this and he's going to be like, you know what, F this?

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA is a business, and players must be prepared to move
quotes.excerpt: I think he understands the league's a business and that eventually he might not retire here.
quotes.quote: I think he understands the league's a business and that eventually he might not retire here. Paul Pierce didn't retire here, obviously Garnett. These days there's no Dirks anymore, right? You're not going to play your entire career with one team. I think he's understanding, knowing that the NBA is a business, that eventually it might be time to move on.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Callahan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's desire to be the number one option
quotes.excerpt: He can't do that here. Jason Tatum is the one and he knows that.
quotes.quote: If being the number one option and in that way proving doubters wrong or making it apparent I can be the number one, I can carry a team, he can't do that here. Jason Tatum is the one and he knows that. And I think having proven it and done it and shown it to everyone, that might be the reason to ask out of.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Callahan
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens has been aggressive in making roster trades
quotes.excerpt: Brad Stevens has made a lot of actual trades that did not involve him.
quotes.quote: Brad Stevens has made a lot of actual trades that did not involve him. We start with Kemba Walker, going down Aaron Nesmith and the Malcolm Brogdon deal. Kristaps Porzingis, welcome aboard. Hello Jrue Holiday, goodbye Jrue Holiday, and then goodbye KP. So that's more than an average of a trade per season, Gary. This I think would obviously be the biggest, the boldest.

quotes.speaker: Andrew Callahan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's tenure and success compared to Marcus Smart
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown has been here longer than Marcus Smart was. He's a better player, he's won a championship.
quotes.quote: The problem is Jaylen Brown has been here longer than Marcus Smart was. He's a better player, he's won a championship. Let's just stay in our hearts. Are you ready for Jaylen Brown era to be over and would Brad do this, do you think?

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens is a cold-blooded decision-maker regarding trades
quotes.excerpt: He's a cold-blooded guy when it comes to making trades.
quotes.quote: I think Brad would do anything. He's a cold-blooded guy when it comes to making trades and he'll patch you on the back out the door and they'll come back and get a big standing O and Eddie Paladino will say your name in his voice, but he'll still trade you away.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum have unfinished business
quotes.excerpt: I think Jaylen and Jason still have unfinished business. I think that they still have work to do.
quotes.quote: I think Jaylen and Jason still have unfinished business. I think that they still have work to do. Do I think Jason is like calling Giannis and saying, yeah, we need to play together? I think Jason would adjust, I think Jaylen will adjust, I think both understand this league's a business, but I think they both still have some unfinished business.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics need to prioritize athleticism on the wing
quotes.excerpt: They need to get a more athletic wing as Brad said. They need to get more athletic.
quotes.quote: They need to get a more athletic wing as Brad said. They need to get more athletic. And I've asked a lot of people this, in your guys' opinion, who's the most athletic player in the Celtics? Jordan Walsh or Jaylen? And Jaylen is no longer the athlete he was seven, eight years ago, he's more physical.
